scope: Source-authored T736 LPDDR4 host components, not complete PHY electrical initialization or training

validation.historical_outputs: Earlier spl/lpddr4/phy/build and check-result.json are retained as history, excluded from source inputs and current validation evidence

sources.use: Read-only corroboration of shared T736 host APB widths, reset/stall bits, DQ selector addresses, and PLL bit24/clock sequencing. No LP5 presets, tables, PIE words or PMU algorithms imported.

sources.title: T736 User Manual v0.90
sources.use: PLL_DDR enable/LDO/lock/output and N/P0/M1 fields; CCU clock update (including gates), NSI/MBUS/DRAM0 source/divider/gate and NSI/DRAM0 BGR reset/gate. PLL bit24 is reserved in this manual and has no invented semantic name.
Read-only inspection of host-interface code, not execution or import
Only corroborates MicroContMuxSel CSR d0000 and MicroReset d0099 nomenclature, Stall bit0/Reset bit3. Other DDR5 register layouts conflict and are not used as Type9 definitions.

confirmed_host_mapping.rule: These are confirmed host physical addresses, not a universal ARC-to-host arithmetic mapping

DQ_selectors.mapping_direction: Caller must supply verified PHY CSR selector order; no schematic conversion inferred

opaque_bit24.limit: Board-specific opaque control, not a generic documented bit or proof of LP4 PHY readiness

pll_1800_profile.safety_contract: SRAM-only with all DRAM clients stopped; DRAM0 clock/configuration bus gates off before PLL writes. NSI source SYS24M or PERI0_600M and MBUS source SYS24M or PERI0_400M, with DFS/update idle; fabric registers are preserved. PERI0 must already be valid when selected.
sequence: disable PLL enable and lock detection
bounded three-consecutive-lock qualification with confirmed 1us gaps
enable output while downstream consumers remain gated
pll_1800_profile.manual_priority_correction: Manual 4.1.4.1 Method2 requires LDO before parameters/PLL_EN and a post-lock 20us interval; the SDK/public host trace delays before polling and is not followed for this timing. The manual's three-time lock wording is implemented as conservative consecutive status observations, not an invented analog adjustment.
pll_1800_profile.output_gate_caution: Manual warns Method2 output gating can glitch at startup. DRAM0 is gated and NSI/MBUS must use accepted independent sources until the transition completes.
pll_1800_profile.timer_failure_behavior: Abort immediately without advancing the sequence; callback must report actual elapsed time or a failure

hardware_evidence.context: SRAM/FEL after early Boot0, retaining existing independent PERI0 fabric clocks; not a pristine ROM-to-source boot

ccu_cold_component.register_name_correction: Inspected public driver calls 0x2580/0x2584 MBUS and 0x2588 DRAM_MUX. Manual confirms NSI_CLK/NSI_BGR/MBUS_CLK; current macros use those names.
preconditions: SRAM-only early cold context with interrupts/DMA/DRAM clients stopped
main NSI running SYS24M or PERI0_600M with main/configuration resets deasserted and configuration gate on
selected PERI0 clock already valid; its initialization is outside this component
no NSI/MBUS DFS and no in-flight CCU update
if controllers are already clocked/out of reset, both STAT modes must be INIT
stages: DRAM0 clock and configuration bus isolated
DRAM0 configuration reset released before gate
ccu_cold_component.unchanged_clock_configuration: Skip UPD when active readback already equals requested value; avoids a redundant DRAM0 req/ack before the selected DDRPLL is running
ccu_cold_component.fabric_rationale: Real early-Boot0 FEL uses NSI source3 PERI0_600M and MBUS source4 PERI0_400M, both documented independent sources. Preserve all values and the communication path; do not force SYS24M or reset NSI. SYS24M is also accepted for a later fully source-initialized path.
not_claimed: independent PERI0 initialization or completed cold clock tree

next_domain_contract_findings.sdk_lp4_dramc_sys_cfg: mctl_channel_init uses 0x0a020010: clears 0x14 and 0x28, updates 0x3f3f mask to dual-channel 0x2728, later performs reset/clock transitions in the same register
next_domain_contract_findings.sdk_type_channel: 0x0a020014 bit1 selects the dual-channel branch; bit0 is set only for SDK dram_type==9. Existing board observation is 2. SDK dram_type numbering is separate from the PHY Type9 revision, and dram_type==9 must not be labelled LP4.
next_domain_contract_findings.public_prcm_candidate_conflict: Public sun60i_a733_dmc_clock_setup applies 0x2728 and feature fields to 0x07010310/+314 and 0x07410310/+314. That additional PRCM mapping is not corroborated by the inspected LP4 host path; it is not a runtime write here.
next_domain_contract_findings.sdk_memory_isolation: mctl_channel_init sets 0x07010250 bit0, then waits 10000us before controller/PHY init
next_domain_contract_findings.smc_workaround_source: /home/ubuntu/t736-aiot/tina/brandy/arisc/ar100s/service/standby/standby-sun60iw2p1/plat_standby.c: sunxi_smc_en_with_glitch_workaround only acts when chip is secure, clearing SMC_ACTION_REG in both SMC instances
next_domain_contract_findings.smc_source_use: Read-only register-interface facts. Source header is All Rights Reserved; no code is copied. Addresses, chip-security precondition and warm/cold applicability need a separate corroborated contract.
requires_real_lp4_executor: DRAM RESET_n/CKE timing and LP4 device command initialization

read_only_board_probe.result: MuxSel=1; probe stopped before MicroReset/internal CSR reads; no writes; insmod/rmmod succeeded

calibration_and_command_interface.reason: Type9 electrical/command field definitions remain to be corroborated; raw LP5 constants and vendor sequencer words are not substitutes

sdk_dram_type_branch_facts_only.finding: all four DBYTE slices: dram_type==9 writes 0; other path writes 0x400

calibration_and_command_interface.candidate_policy: Facts only, not included as runtime writes. SDK dram_type==9 is not the PHY Type9 revision and is not established as the board's LP4 type. No claim that these establish CA SDR/DDR mode, command-RAM descriptor format, RESET_n or CKE controls.
